'''Zephyrus''' was a [[Slavery/Legends|slavemaster]] who, in [[1100 BBY/Legends|1100 BBY]], outfitted the [[slave caravel]] ''[[Sickly Tremor]]'' with [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] cages to bring slaves he claimed could heft a [[Skiff/Legends|cargo skiff]] in one hand to [[Ovise III]]. However, the shipment never arrived, and Zephyrus's fate remained a mystery, although it was theorized his ship crashed on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], and that the slaves he boasted of were ancestors of the moon's [[Phlog/Legends|Phlog]] population.
